response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack engineering skills and experience with event-driven systems, but lacks explicit evidence of executive-level leadership, multi-agent AI production experience, or fintech-specific domain expertise. His background in developer tooling and open-source contributions suggests technical depth, but the role requires proven CTO-level impact in agentic AI and fintech infrastructure.
strengths: Strong full-stack and distributed systems experience, including event-driven architectures and real-time data processing.
Hands-on contributions to AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators) and developer tooling at re:cinq.
Proven track record of open-source leadership (e.g., GISCollective) and technical mentorship through workshops/talks.
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience or evidence of scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ people.
Lacks demonstrated production experience with multi-agent AI systems in regulated/high-stakes environments (e.g., fintech).
Fintech exposure is limited to indirect experience (e.g., pricing optimization at Optilyz) rather than core infrastructure (credit systems, risk modeling).
